Proposed · Settings and the alo window · 2026-10-31

A proposal for the owner — revised 2026-10-31 after the owner’s review: no vendor is shown as something alo provides (“My provider” and “my-model” are what a person typed); the five places an answer can come from are drawn; selections and switches follow the person’s accent; section headings are in sentence case. Example content (folder names, dates, Belgium) is illustrative.

Settings · light · 1440×960 · Indigo — alo and AI, Folders alo can use, Running code, Terminal, Appearance, Region and time, choosing the country, Keyboard and shortcuts, Accessibility, and alo and AI scrolled to the end
Settings · how it adapts at 1280×800 (Appearance, alo and AI) · dark (alo and AI, Running code) · and Appearance in the Moss accent
The alo window · Working (indicator lit), Waiting for your permission, Complete — 1440×960 · Waiting at 1280×800 · Working in dark
Parts kit — clones and instances of the design’s own alo mark, window edge, composer controls and action buttons, used by the frames above. Not a screen.

How this computer looks, and where the Dock sits.
Following the time of day turns dark in the evening and light again in the morning.
Each colour has a version for light and for dark, so it reads properly either way.
The whole of alo OS follows the accent: selections, switches and choices. Deep teal is not offered: it means alo is acting, and nothing else.
The Dock keeps its place on its edge of the screen.
